title: The Anointing of God Brings Life-Changing Power
description: In this powerful sermon, Pastor Chris Zehner explores the manifest presence of God and how it brings transformation and healing to our lives. As we delve into Luke chapter 5, we discover that the anointing is not just a feeling, but a tangible presence that brings about tangible results. Join Pastor Chris as he shares practical insights and biblical truth on how to tap into the anointing and experience the life-changing power of God.
